name: Enkou JK no Amai Wana
source:
As a building manager in my mid-40s I figured it was too late to do anything fun with a young girl.
I mean, there was no reason I would have a chance, right?
Then, out of nowhere, this precocious teen propositioned me on the street.

"Hey ojisan, if you have some free time wanna play? Let's do something naaaaaughy hee hee!"

She was a cocktease in a school uniform, and she rescued me from tedium.
Sure, I was an unmarried middle aged guy resorting to prostitution to purge my sexual frustrations.
I loved her anyway, because she gave me the gift of new thrills at a time of life when I'd given up.

But... was this mere paid dating? Or could it be......

translation:
作为一名40多岁的大楼经理，我认为现在和一个年轻女孩做任何有趣的事情已经太晚了。
我的意思是，我没有理由有机会，对吧？
然后，突然间，这个早熟的青少年在街上向我求婚。

“嘿，ojisan，如果你有空闲时间想玩吗？我们来做点什么吧，嘿嘿嘿！”

她穿着校服，是个调皮的人，她把我从沉闷中解救出来。
当然，我是一个未婚的中年男子，通过卖淫来消除我的性挫败感。
无论如何，我爱她，因为当我放弃生命的时候，她给了我新的刺激的礼物。

但是……这只是付费约会吗？或者说是……
